description: This file defines the LeaveRequestCommentDecorator class, which serves as a decorator/wrapper for the LeaveRequestComment entity. It provides methods for setting related entities (Employee, User, LeaveRequest) by IDs and retrieving formatted creation date/time strings.

classes.name: LeaveRequestCommentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the LeaveRequestComment entity that provides setter methods for related entities and formatted date/time getters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a LeaveRequestComment entity.

methods.name: setCreatedByEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee who created the comment, based on employee number.

methods.name: setCreatedByUserById
methods.description: Sets the user who created the comment, based on user ID.

methods.name: setLeaveRequestById
methods.description: Associates a leave request to the comment, based on leave request ID.

methods.name: getCreatedAtDate
methods.description: Returns the creation date of the comment in 'Y-m-d' format.

methods.name: getCreatedAtTime
methods.description: Returns the creation time of the comment in 'H:i' format.
